note: Van Buren County, Iowa publishes no queryable zoning district service. Keosauqua's zoning map is a PDF (keosauqua.com city resources). The county assessor's GIS is a CAMAvision viewer with parcel and flood layers and no zoning service found. The county ordinance index lists no zoning ordinance. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the state/county GIS directories found no zoning FeatureServer or MapServer for the county or its towns (Birmingham, Bonaparte, Farmington, Milton, Stockport, Cantril).
